main_text.l: צָעַק Clamare, Exclamare, Vociferari. Niphal נִצְעַק Convocari. Pihel צִעֵּק Clamitare. Hiphil הִצְעִיק Convocavit.
צָעִיר m. Parvus, Exiguus, Minor. Plurale, צְעִירִים Minores fem. צְעִירָה Minima, Minor natu puella, & substantivè Minoritas, Minorennitas.
צָפָה Speculari, Explorare, Observare, Exspectare. Pihel צִפָּה Idem: item Obtexit, Obduxit. Pyhal מְצֻפָּה Obducta.

page.notes: Scan is slightly blurred; Hebrew vowel points and some letters in the first entries are uncertain and may not be exact. The catchword צפן is at lower right. The running head is read as printed but is partly faint.
